passages.provision_quote: any application for registration shall be accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship as prescribed in section 16-166, subsection F, and the county recorder or other officer in charge of elections shall reject any application for registration that is not accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship.
passages.note: Enacted text of HB2492 requires satisfactory evidence of citizenship to register to vote.

rows.reasoning: Hoffman prime-sponsored and voted Y (House Third Reading, 31-26-3-0-0) on HB 2492 (2022), a single-subject Arizona bill 'relating to qualification and registration of electors' whose enacted text requires satisfactory evidence of citizenship to register, matching 'Require documentary proof of citizenship to register to vote.' The action was taken in the Arizona House and counts as in-term for his current State Senate seat under the same-legislature ruling.
